ran_in: seeon-ml-worker-flow:dev (pinned DeepStream 9.1 base) on an RTX 5070 Ti
asserts: no CUDA context is current on the calling thread before or after a device-to-host tensor copy
the flow packages import neither torch nor cupy
the image ships no CUDAExecutionProvider for ONNX Runtime
the device primary context state is unchanged by loading ORT
limit: The driver exposes primary-context state and the current context per thread; it cannot enumerate every context a process holds. Combined with the no-other-CUDA-client import assert and the single GPU process observed by nvidia-smi, this is the strongest available form of P1b-AC7.
